cases.name: recipient-pull-production-lost-receipt
cases.intent: drop the shipped recipient's completion request after applying a synthetic credential
cases.expected_postcondition: recipient application persists, broker retains uncertain status, and CLI output discloses no credential

cases.name: recipient-pull-production-recipient-restart
cases.intent: restart the shipped recipient from its persistent operation journal and retry lost completion against a restarted broker
cases.expected_postcondition: idempotent receipt retry reconciles uncertainty without replaying the credential write
cases.observed_postcondition: completed after retry; installed synthetic value remains present

residual_risks: real AegisKeys credential resolution, grant policy, and rotation not exercised
provider and recipient side effects are independently observed only in the full cross-broker qualification
recipient application identity beyond UID pinning not proven
